translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Bab Dummadse naegala, Jesúsbi unnila igar-napiragwadid
Jesús na e-sapinganga sogded: “Mer surbinsa be-gwagegi be itomalo. Bab Dummadgi mer be bengumalo, degine, mer angi be bengumarbalo.
An-Bab-neggi neg-nuegan-bukidar nikad, ar degisulina, deyob an bega sogsasurmalanad. Ar emigindi an nae, bemar-idu bemarga neg guagwar sinaegar.
An bemar-idu namalad, bemarga neg guagwar sismalale, gannar an danibaloed, bemar-sudagegar, adi bia an gudiguoedgi, agi bemar anba gudigumogagar.
Ar bemar wismalad bia an nasokali, degine, igar-maid bemar wismarbalid.”
Tomás Jesúsga sogded: —Dummad, ar anmar wichulid bia be nasokali, degite, ¿igi anmar wisguosunna, bia igar maid?
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Anbi unnila Bab Dummadse be-sedoed, ani an napiragwadid, degine, dula gudigued angi danikid. Dule-wargwensaale geg Bab Dummadse warmaked, ar angi nasulir.
Ar mag be an-dakena, an doa-dule, an-Bab mag be dakmarmoganad. Ar emigindi bemar mag an-Bab-dakmaloed, ar ade bemar bato an-Bab-daksamalad.
Felipe Jesúsga sogded: —Dummad, Bab Dummad be anmarga oyoge, geb agine anmar gusbin itogoed.

Jesús, abin-sogded: —Felipe, ar dikasurgus an bemar-abargi gudiidde, degite, ¿amba be aku an-dakde? Ar dule an-daksale, a-dule bato an-Bab-daksamodo. Degite, ¿ibiga be anse egissunna: Bab be anga oyoye?
¿Ar be bensi, Babgi an gudiid, degine, Bab angi gudimogad? Ar ibmar an sogedi, an-itolegedba wargwen an sogsulid, ar Bab-angi-maiddi, a angi ibmar imaked.
Mer be bengumar, an-Babgi an gudiid, degi, Bab angi gudimogad. Ar degisulile, an-ibmar-imakedgi be dakmar, mer be an-bengumar.
Ar napira an bemarga soged: Ar dule angi bensulile, an-ibmar-saedi, imakmogoed. Degine, a-dule bur-bule ibmar-dummagan imakoed, ar ade an-Babse an naesokalid.
Ar bela an-nuggi an-Babse be ibmar egisele, an bega imakoed, adi Bab na E-Machigi nug-ganguegar.
Ar ibmar-gwensak an-nuggi be egisele, an bega imakoed.
Jesús sogsad, Bab Dummad Burba Nued an barmidagoye
Jesús sogdebar: “Ar be an-sabmalale, an-igar-mamaidba be damaloed.
An-Babse an bemarga egisoed, adi be bendaked-baid, bemar-Gwage-Armaked, bemarga barmidagega, ar adi degi-sadegu bemarba gudiguegar.

We-Burba-Nued napiragwadbi Bab Dummadgi sunmaked. We-napneggi dulemar-Bab-Dummad-wichurmalad we-Burba-Napiragwad geg abingaed, ar ade daksurmalad, deginbali, amba aku dakmarbalid. Ar bemardi we-Burba-Napiragwad-mag-daked, ar bemarba gudiid, degine, bemargi gudigubaloed.
“Wargwen, nusgana-babgan-sulidyob, an bemar-metosurmalad. An bemarse gannar danibaloed.
Ar amba emi bipisaale, we-napneg-naidgi-bukmalad bar an-dakosulid, ar bemardi an-dakmaloed, ar an dula gudisoggu, bemar dula gudigumosunnoed.
A-ibagine bemar mag itogoed, an-Babgi an gudiid, bemar angi gudimogad, degine, an bemargi gudimogad.
Ar dule an-igar-mamaid sediile, degine, ar aba gudiile, we-dule nue-an-sabed. Ar dule an-sabele, an-Bab sabgumogoed, degine, a-dule an sabgumogoed, degine, an ese magarobaloed an doa-dule gue.”
Jesúsga Judas sogded (Judas-Iscariotesur): —Dummad, ¿igi nabir anmarse be magarogoe, ar dulemar-beba-naisurmaladsedi be magarogosulid?
Jesús abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Ar dule an-sabele, an-gaya-burba-sunmakedba daoed, degine, an-Bab a-dule-sabgumogoed, degine, anmar a-dulese danikoed, a-dulegi megegar.
Ar dule an-sabsulile, an-gaya-burba-sunmakedba daosulid. Ar bemar-an-sunmaked-itosmaladi, an wargwen ibmar sogsasulid, an-Bab-an-barmialidi, a-sogedba ibmar an soged.
“We-ibmar-an-bemarga-sogsadi, bemar-abargi gudigu, an bemarga sogsamalad.
Ar Dule-Bemar-Gwage-Armaked, Bab Dummad Burba Nued, an-nuggi Bab barmidagoedi, a bela bemar-odurdaknonikoed, degine, bela-an-ibmar-sogsad gannar insaega bemar-imakoed.

“Ulubgi-bogidik-itogega an bemar-imaked, an na ulubgi-bogidik-itogedyob an bemar-imakmogad. Ulubgi bogidik itogega an bemar-imakedi we-napneg-naid imakedyobsulid. Mer be surbinsa be-gwagegi be itomar, mer be dobgumarbar.
Ar an-bega-sogsamalad bemar itosad: ‘An nae, gannar an bemarse danibaloed.’ Ar bemar an-sabmalana weligwar be itosmalanad, ar bemarga an sogsad an Babse an naye, ar an-Bab anba bur dummad.
Ar emigindi idu bemarga an sogsad, adi deyob gunonikile, mer be angi bengumalagar.
“Bemarga bar suitii an sunmakosulid, ar we-napneggi-dummadga-gudiid, nia-saila danikid, ar angi e-gangued obinsur-inigwele, deyob guer-gebed.
Adi we-napneggi-dulemar-bukmalad wisguegala, an Bab-sabed, degine, Bab Dummad an-barmialidba an ibmar imaked.” Jesús bela weyob odurdaksad-sorba e-sapinganga sogded: “Gwisgumar, wegi anmar namarsun.”
